name: sitemap-builder
description: Get a static website ready for search engines: point it at the site folder and get a correct sitemap.xml and robots.txt, with clean URLs, last-modified dates, change frequency and priority you can adjust per page. Pages marked noindex or with a canonical elsewhere are left out, and every internal link, image, script and stylesheet is checked so broken links are listed before you publish. Runs locally on your files; no crawler service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让静态网站准备好被搜索引擎收录：选网站文件夹，生成正确的 sitemap.xml 和 robots.txt，支持简洁网址、最后修改日期、更新频率和优先级，每个页面都可以单独调整。标了 noindex 或 canonical 指向别处的页面会自动排除；站内的每个链接、图片、脚本和样式表都会检查，发布前就能看到所有坏链接。在本地读取文件，不用爬虫服务，无需 API 密钥。
